title: Code and data for: Accuracy, Decision Risk, and Sampling Cost in Quantum Error Mitigation
description: Code, archived measurement records and reproducible analyses relating estimation accuracy, candidate-selection risk and sampling cost in quantum error mitigation. The package includes the v45 manuscript, signed-PEC controls and E1 partition sensitivity. The separate E2 shot archive supports replay from individual measurement rounds.
notes:
Code: MIT. Numerical outputs, original figures and measurement data: CC BY 4.0, as specified in LICENSE-DATA.
